**1 — Scene:** A mixed plate of pizza pieces and skin-on fish over a lentil-and-leaf salad, with crumbled white cheese. The fish appears to be an oily variety, possibly mackerel.

**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, roughly 26–28 cm across. Using a **26 cm equivalent diameter** gives an estimated usable area of **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**. Food on the neighboring plates is excluded.

**3 — Items:** Cheese pizza; tomato/onion pizza; cooked skin-on fish; cooked lentils; leafy greens; crumbled white cheese, likely feta. No distinct pool of sauce or separately measurable oil is visible.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Areas below partition the food footprint without counting overlapping ingredients twice. Heights represent each ingredient’s estimated layer thickness.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cheese pizza, lower pieces | 20% | 106 × 1.3 = 138 ml | 0.9 → 124 g | 270 | 335 |
| Tomato/onion pizza, upper pieces | 18% | 96 × 1.3 = 125 ml | 0.9 → 112 g | 250 | 280 |
| Skin-on fish | 23% | 122 × 1.2 = 146 ml | 0.95 → 139 g | 220 | 306 |
| Cooked lentils | 10% | 53 × 1.8 = 95 ml | 0.8 → 76 g | 115 | 87 |
| Leafy greens | 6% | 32 × 2 = 64 ml | 0.15 → 10 g | 20 | 2 |
| Crumbled feta-like cheese | 2% | 11 × 0.8 = 9 ml | 0.9 → 8 g | 265 | 21 |

**Area check:** 20 + 18 + 23 + 10 + 6 + 2 = **79% covered**, consistent with the visible empty plate margins.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **469 g and 1,030 kcal** is plausible for several small pizza pieces plus fish and lentil salad. The greens and cheese remain small quantities. Fish identity and pizza thickness are the main uncertainties.
